getCredentials builds the recovery model with createFromValues which leaves getId() null, so callers like removeStoredCredentialById receive null and cannot remove the credential

Javadoc for requireView() and requireViewClientScopes() incorrectly states they return true, but they are void methods that throw ForbiddenException
Unused private getEvaluationContext method in ClientPermissionsV2 is never called because canExchangeTo throws UnsupportedOperationException, leaving dead code and unused imports

Javadoc for requireViewClientScopes() claims it returns a boolean but it is a void method that throws ForbiddenException when access is denied
Per-client resources suppress all-clients permissions because hasPermission evaluates only the per-client resource and never checks the Clients resource when a per-client resource exists

getGroupIdsWithViewPermission passes groupResource.getId() to hasPermission and adds it to granted instead of using getName() which holds the group ID, causing findByName to miss the group resource and callers like getUsersCount to receive invalid group IDs
GroupPermissionsV2.canManage() checks VIEW alongside MANAGE scope, allowing an admin granted only view on the all-groups resource to pass requireManage() and create top-level groups

concatenatedRSToASN1DER method has two standalone ASN1Encoder.create().write(...) calls that encode rBigInteger and sBigInteger into discarded encoders, wasting work since the returned bytes come entirely from the subsequent writeDerSeq chain

createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts an anonymous Thread without calling join() before checking caughtExceptions, so exceptions thrown in the reader thread after deletedAll.set(true) are missed and the test passes anyway

createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti runs assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty()) right after deletedAll.set(true) without joining the reader thread, so an in-flight read can add an exception to caughtExceptions after the check and let the test pass while still broken

GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount() returns null when a group was concurrently removed, violating GroupModel.getSubGroupsCount()'s non-null contract and causing callers that unbox the Long to throw an NPE
isConditionalPasskeysEnabled returns false when context.getUser() is null, causing webauthnAuth.fillContextForm to be skipped on fresh logins and dropping the conditional passkeys UI

_create_process_for_shard is never called - dead code with no callers since startup and restart go through _create_process_for_shards

isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) is false for SpawnProcess instances created by self.mp_context.Process, so hung processes are never killed before replacements start, allowing duplicate processes to flush the same shards
get_memory_info is called once per buffer instead of once for the cluster, repeating the cluster INFO scan and inflating used and available metrics by N times on every submit
wait_produce timer tags 'shards' instead of 'shard', inconsistent with produce and segment_size_bytes metrics, breaking dashboard grouping
join breaks on timeout before calling process.terminate() on remaining processes, leaving flusher processes running after join returns

tableResultComponent passes empty tableData and columns to TableWidgetVisualization - when use-table-widget-visualization is enabled, it renders with columns={[]} and data: [] instead of result.data and result.meta, so dashboard table widgets show no rows or headers

self.initial_data.get(...) treats 0 as absent in BrowserReportSerializer - validate_timestamp and validate_age test the other field by truthiness, so a report containing both age and timestamp skips mutual-exclusion validation when either field is 0
fetch_error_details zips error_ids with events.values() from nodestore.backend.get_multi by position, so missing or reordered nodes cause ErrorEvent.id to be paired with the wrong error data

analytics.record runs before the features.has check and validation in OrganizationPreprodArtifactAssembleEndpoint.post, so rejected requests (404s and 400s) are recorded as assemble attempts and inflate the metric
OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result slices queryset with negative cursor.offset, causing Django to fail since querysets don't support negative indexing
OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key calls math.floor on a datetime, raising TypeError when ordered by -datetime on non-empty pages
Comment claims negative offsets are allowed when start_offset actually clamps them to zero, making the comment inaccurate
organization_context.member.has_global_access dereferences a null member without checking if member is None, causing AttributeError for API key and org auth token requests
start_offset can be negative when cursor.is_prev is true and offset < 0, causing Django QuerySet slicing to raise an exception
value_from_cursor returns the int cursor value unchanged instead of converting to datetime, causing database comparison failures
bleveBackend.TotalDocs iterates b.cache without acquiring b.cacheMu, causing potential panic from concurrent map iteration and map write when searchSupport.init starts the watch goroutine
The dbType == "postgres" check calls t.Skip before InitializeModuleServer, so the eager NewResourceServer initialization is never tested under postgres and startup failures pass CI unnoticed

BuildIndex no longer blocks concurrent builds of the same key - the lock now covers only the cache write, so two concurrent builds of the same key can both call bleve.New on the same directory, causing errors or corrupting the file-backed index

MetricAlertDetectorHandler subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler without implementing abstract methods counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data, causing TypeError when instantiated
build_mock_occurrence_and_event ignores its value argument, causing test_state_results_multi_group to build expected occurrence for group_2 with 6 instead of the packet's 10
Docstring in StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate incorrectly states it returns a list when it actually returns dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]

get_monitor_environment_context updates a copied config but returns monitor_environment.monitor.config, discarding the local config and leaving the raw schedule_type in the occurrence's monitor context

queued: datetime = timezone.now() evaluates once at module import time, so every AssignmentSource instance built without an explicit value gets the process-start timestamp instead of when the assignment was queued, causing to_dict() and outbound tasks to carry stale values. Should use field(default_factory=timezone.now) instead.

test_thread_queue_parallel_error_handling asserts that offsets are not committed after processing errors, but it exits after only 0.2s while _commit_loop waits 1.0s, so it races the worker's commit and passes vacuously regardless of whether failed offsets are completed

FixedQueuePool creates unbounded queue.Queue() instances without a maxsize, so submit never blocks and queues grow without limit under backlog, contradicting SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy's documented backpressure guarantee

OrderedQueueWorker.run calls complete_offset in finally after result_processor raises, so failed offsets are marked done and committed instead of retried, contradicting the docstring claim that offsets are only committed after successful processing

test_stats_reporting asserts stats['total_items'] > 0 after submitting items while worker threads are already draining the queues, causing the assertion to fail nondeterministically when workers drain them first

FixedQueuePool.shutdown sets worker.shutdown = True before calling q.shutdown(immediate=False), causing OrderedQueueWorker.run to exit after its current item and abandon remaining queued messages without completing their offsets

Any exception from self.grouping_fn(result) or self.decoder is logged, then the offset is added and completed, so the offset is committed while the message is dropped with no retry and no error surfaced

queryset[start_offset:stop] slices with a negative start_offset when enable_advanced_features is set and cursor.offset < 0, causing Django to reject with ValueError: Negative indexing is not supported
OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key calls math.floor on a datetime value without converting it to a number first, causing TypeError in build_cursor
BasePaginator.get_result passes negative start_offset to queryset when cursor.is_prev is true and offset < 0, causing AssertionError in Django
organization_context.member.has_global_access dereferences a None member when RpcUserOrganizationContext.member is None for callers without membership, raising AttributeError
Removed max_segment_spans guard in _load_segment_data without replacement, allowing segments with excessive span counts to be loaded
add-buffer.lua redirect loop bound dropped from 10000 to 1000, causing redirect chains deeper than 1000 hops to stop early and leave set_span_id unresolved

_is_error_focused_query matches the substring event.type:error without parsing, so negated or compound queries like !event.type:error incorrectly replace count() with upsampled_count() over non-error events without a sample_weight, giving wrong counts

hash() in error_upsampling_eligible cache key varies across processes because Python randomizes hash() per process, so workers miss shared cache entries and invalidate_upsampling_cache fails to evict keys set by other processes

TestService_CacheCheck sets the cached permission to false, causing checkPermission to deny on its own and assert.False to pass even if permDenialCache is bypassed, leaving the denial cache untested. Should set 'dashboards:uid:dash1': true so the test only passes if permDenialCache produces the denial.

Denial cache keys can collide for distinct resource names and folders due to ambiguous underscore separators - (name='a_b', parent='c') and (name='a', parent='b_c') produce the same key, causing a denial for one request to incorrectly deny the other. Should encode each key component unambiguously, such as by length-prefixing values before concatenation.

test_installation_not_found passes a hardcoded state that mismatches pipeline.signature, so OAuthLoginView returns an error before GitHubInstallation runs and the registered 404 installation stub is never tested
integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] raises KeyError when sender is absent, returning a 500 instead of rendering the error page
state = pipeline.signature uses an md5 of pipeline view class names that is identical for every user, so the callback check accepts forged states and provides no CSRF protection

safe_urlopen for the token exchange runs before the try that guards safe_urlread, so if GitHub returns an error status or the connection fails, the exception escapes and the user gets a 500 instead of the github-integration-failed page
get_user_info calls resp.raise_for_status() outside any try, so a 401 or 5xx from GitHub raises requests.HTTPError, the pipeline 500s, and the user never sees the Invalid installation request dialog

Cached login results skip organization-aware wrapping - the cache-hit path returns models from session.identityProviders().getById(id) directly while the cache-miss path wraps results with createOrganizationAwareIdentityProviderModel, causing cached results to omit organization-aware behavior

enableSqlExpressions returns false on every path regardless of featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions, so ReadQuery rejects every sql query with 'sqlExpressions is not implemented' even when the flag is enabled

SQL expressions are always disabled because enableSqlExpressions returns false on every path, so the QueryTypeSQL case always returns 'sqlExpressions is not implemented' even when the feature flag is enabled
GetWebAssets does not re-check entryPointAssetsCache after acquiring Lock, causing concurrent cache misses to repeatedly reload assets-manifest.json
A failed read can overwrite a valid cache with nil because there is no re-check of the cache after acquiring the lock

time.NewTicker(time.Minute * 1) runs cleanup ten times too often - CleanUpService.Run calls srv.clean every minute instead of every ten, causing all cleanup jobs to run ten times as often while clean can take up to 9 minutes, increasing database load and lock contention

Cleanup logs normal batch progress at Error level - Normal batches in CleanAnnotations and CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags call r.log.Error with ids and a nil err, flooding error logs and alerts with routine progress lines
Create calls recordLegacyDuration on d.Storage.Create failure - when d.Storage.Create fails, storage failures are recorded on the legacy histogram while the storage histogram misses them
Update calls recordLegacyDuration when d.Storage.Update fails - storage update errors are recorded on the legacy histogram while the storage histogram receives no error sample

d.recordStorageDuration called for d.Legacy.DeleteCollection - the legacy DeleteCollection goroutine calls d.recordStorageDuration, so legacy duration and errors are attributed to the storage histogram while the legacy metric receives no observation

Delete passes name instead of options.Kind to recordStorageDuration - on the success path, Delete calls d.recordStorageDuration with name instead of options.Kind, writing the object name into the kind label and breaking queries grouped by kind

Delete stores d.Log in the context instead of log - Delete calls klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log) instead of passing log, dropping the name, kind, and method fields from all log lines emitted downstream by d.Storage.Delete

Create records storage failure on legacy histogram - when d.Storage.Create fails, Create calls d.recordLegacyDuration with startStorage, so storage failures are attributed to the legacy histogram while the storage histogram misses them

Legacy update no longer receives the storage-updated object - the removed code wrapped objInfo with the object returned by Storage.Update; this call passes the original objInfo to legacy instead, so legacy can independently compute an update rather than applying the canonical storage result
GrafanaRuleListItem in FilterView is missing a key prop, causing React to fall back to index reconciliation which can reuse component state across different rules when the list updates

Delete menu item requires rulerRule alongside canDelete, so in list views where only promRule is provided and rulerRule is undefined, the Delete action is never rendered even when delete permission is granted

createRelativeUrl builds the view href without returnTo from createReturnTo(), so opening a Grafana rule from a filtered list loses the return path and navigating back no longer returns to that list

runSplitQuery maps applyTemplateVariables over request.targets before DataSourceWithBackend.query applies applyTemplateVariables again, causing ad hoc filters on parsed labels to be appended twice and variable values containing $ to be substituted twice

runShardSplitQuery calls applyTemplateVariables on targets before passing them to runSplitQuery, which runs applyTemplateVariables again, causing addAdHocFilters to duplicate ad hoc filters on shard sub-requests without deduplication

tagDeviceUI caches the device key before CreateOrUpdateDevice succeeds, so when CreateOrUpdateDevice returns ErrDeviceLimitReached, the next request hits the cache and admits the over-limit device without storing or counting it

CreateOrUpdateDevice counts and inserts devices non-atomically - it calls CountDevices and then inserts in a separate session without a lock, so concurrent requests can both read a count below deviceLimit and insert, causing stored devices to exceed the configured limit
tagDeviceUI runs localCache.SetDefault before CreateOrUpdateDevice returns ErrDeviceLimitReached, so subsequent requests hit the cache and grant anonymous access without storing the device

TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh TestLogger instead of the receiver f, so calls like m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...) write to a discarded instance and assertions on InfoLogs or ErrorLogs see nothing

LoggerMiddleware.logRequest previously extracted traceID via tracing.TraceIDFromContext and appended it to logParams, but no added line in LoggerMiddleware or ContextualLoggerMiddleware replaces it, so plugin request logs lose traceID

Raw SQL INSERT stores unnormalized host values - writes legacy embeddable_hosts values with scheme and path intact instead of running EmbeddableHost#before_validation, so EmbeddableHost.record_for_host fails to match uri.host and embedding is blocked on upgraded sites

execute(...)[0]['id'] raises NoMethodError when embed_category has no row - indexes the query result without checking for rows, so when embed_category is unset or matches no category, execute(...)[0] is nil and dereferencing ['id'] raises NoMethodError
self.host.sub! raises NoMethodError when host is nil - before_validation calls self.host.sub! without checking if host is nil, causing 500 instead of validation error

where("lower(host) = ?", host) fails to downcase host - record_for_host lowercases the host column but passes uri.host unchanged, so uppercase letters in referer or embed URL fail to match existing EmbeddableHost record
store.find('fruit', 2) asserts fruit 1's colors - test receives fruits[0] because /fruits/:id pretender ignores requested id, causing test to assert apple's color_ids instead of banana's
Unchecked record lookup in update - EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first returns nil for unknown id, causing save_host(host) to raise NoMethodError and return 500 instead of 404
Unchecked record lookup in destroy - EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first returns nil for unknown id, causing host.destroy to raise NoMethodError and return 500 instead of 404

Fabricator definitions are swapped between category and embeddable_host files - category_fabricator.rb defines :embeddable_host instead of :category, while embeddable_host_fabricator.rb defines category fabricators

dark-light-choose in mobile/modal.scss swaps light and dark lightness values - passes 30% to $primary and 70% to $secondary, causing .custom-message-length to render too dark in light themes and too light in dark themes

dark-light-choose in desktop/topic-post.scss swaps light and dark lightness values - uses 70% lightness for $primary and 30% for $secondary, making .topic-meta-data h5 a too light on light themes and too dark on dark themes

.group-member-info .name in mobile/user.scss uses 50% lightness for $primary and $secondary instead of 30% and 70%, making member names too faint in light themes and too bright in dark themes
totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, returning one page too many when user_count is a multiple of limit, causing showingLast to stay false and next to load an empty page
remove_member spec sends :put instead of :delete, not matching the route definition 'delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"' in config/routes.rb, so controller tests pass while bypassing routing

{{#unless automatic}} evaluates the member instead of the group, leaving automatic undefined and the check always true, which renders the remove link for automatic groups and results in an unhandled 422 upon clicking it
findMembers returns undefined instead of a promise when name is empty, which will throw if any caller chains .then() on findMembers()
BlockedEmail.should_block? looks up the email address case-sensitively without normalizing case, allowing blocked addresses to be bypassed by changing case during signup
